title: Hayati Pro Max Plus Strawberry Raspberry Blueberry Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Strawberry Raspberry Blueberry combines three bright Berry flavours for a sweet and tangy vape. Juicy Strawberry and ripe Blueberry are lifted by Raspberry’s sharper tang, creating a complex, layered fruit mix that tastes clean and exceptioinally well-balanced. Each Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod includes a prefilled 2ml pod with an integrated 10ml refill reservoir, totalling 12ml of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid. There’s no refilling or coil changes to worry about—simply connect to the Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod Kit and vape. The dual mesh coil and MTL setup deliver smooth vapour and clarity of flavour for up to 6000 puffs (approx.). Discover more flavours with our full selection of Hayati Pro Max Plus Pods .
